description: Middle school geometry, measurement, and visual reasoning

cards.back: Perimeter is total distance around a shape.
Surface area is sum of areas of all outer faces.
Acute <90, right =90, obtuse between 90 and 180, straight =180.
Complementary sum to 90. Supplementary sum to 180.
Interior angles of triangle sum to 180 degrees.
In a right triangle, a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
Same shape with proportional side lengths and equal corresponding angles.
Translations slide, reflections flip, rotations turn, dilations resize.
Scale factor multiplies each length in a dilation.
